commentary: With market breadth scoring 43 under a WEAK scanner gate, institutional discipline takes precedence over aggression. Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil cautioned that index gains masking underlying breadth weakness often lead to selective breakouts or false starts. While FII inflows support the benchmark indices, internal participation is divergent. Traders must deploy progressive exposure, demand rigorous CANSLIM fundamental confirmation—specifically accelerating EPS above 25%—and enforce Mark Minervini's risk discipline. Only high-conviction Stage 2 leaders with genuine earnings acceleration warrant focus, while non-qualifying setups are capped at Watch to protect capital.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Constructing a double bottom base above rising 50 and 200-day moving averages with 1.49x volume expansion on the neckline test, but overall relative strength remains poor.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe operational contraction with Q2 net profit declining 25.6% and revenues plunging 56.3% YoY. A substandard 3.1% ROE and negligible margins fail CANSLIM investment criteria completely.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails below the 104.11 pivot stop; cut immediately to avoid trapped capital in illiquid, declining fundamentals.

AARON.technical: Cleared a 20-session high from aligned swing lows with MACD positive divergence, though volume at 1.21x represents only modest institutional demand.
AARON.fundamental: Elevator manufacturing niche generates robust 18.7% ROCE and 15% ROE. Profit expanded 107.2% and sales rose 21.9% YoY, though quarterly growth momentum slowed from Q1's 141.9%.
AARON.risk: Stop loss is pegged strictly at 134.59; close out immediately if the 20-day pivot reverses.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout clearing 20-session resistance on a massive 23.6x volume surge, confirming heavy institutional sponsorship well above key 21, 50, and 200-day moving averages.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Outstanding quarterly performance with profit surging 83.2% and revenue rising 26.6% YoY. EBITDA margin expanded 370 bps to 16.6% driven by formulations and specialty chemicals, confirming O'Neil's C-criterion.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Pattern failure occurs under 441.76; execute hard stop discipline without hesitation if price violates breakout support.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Demonstrates constructive Stage 2 structure, clearing 20-day highs above rising 21, 50, and 200-day moving averages with RSI 72 indicating dominant upside momentum without overextension.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Strong non-banking financial franchise delivering accelerating profit growth of 37.9% on 32.2% top-line expansion, backed by steady 12% ROE and solid lending book traction.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Thesis invalidates below 391.92; exit promptly if distribution forces the stock back beneath the breakout pivot.

ABDL.technical: Double bottom formation maintaining solid support at the rising 21-EMA with RSI at 59, reflecting orderly price consolidation near highs across major moving averages.
ABDL.fundamental: Second-largest Indian spirits maker rebounded to +15% profit and +16% sales growth in Q2, but sub-25% EPS expansion misses CANSLIM's strict high-growth qualification gate.
ABDL.risk: Breach below 712.35 stop invalidates the constructive double-bottom floor; honor the stop to preserve capital.

ABSLBANETF.technical: Banking ETF cleared a 20-session resistance on 1.44x volume, propelled by positive MACD posture and a dual swing-low structure reflecting benchmark banking strength.
ABSLBANETF.risk: Violating the 58.68 stop signals institutional rejection of the banking breakout; cut position immediately.
